name: Add "View on GitHub" to the sidebar comment menu
description: The comments sidebar PR-thread overflow menu only had Delete. Add "View on GitHub" there too, matching the inline comment menu. Local comments are left untouched — they never touch GitHub.

steps.title: View on GitHub in the sidebar PR-thread menu
steps.body: The PR-thread overflow (•••) menu now always renders and exposes **View on GitHub** (opening `root.url` via `window.api.shell.openExternal`), with **Delete** kept behind a separator when the viewer can delete — same shape as the inline `CommentAnnotation` menu, including the `w-auto!` no-wrap fix. The separate local-comments menu is unchanged: local comments have no GitHub permalink.

callouts.body: Opens the comment permalink; no-ops if url is missing.
Menu now renders for url OR canDelete; View on GitHub first, Delete behind a separator.
